Cross Country BC release on Teck Northern Cup race hosted at Bull Mountain.

Cornwall Tourism winter page lists the sanctuary as a cross-country ski trail location.

comment: Operated by St. Lawrence Parks Commission near Ingleside; its campground page (candidate) has no ski mention. Evidence is weak on current grooming; no dated 2024-25+ ski report found. Could use a St. Lawrence Parks winter page if one exists.

evidence.summary: Otonabee Conservation page (2026 season dates) permits winter cross-country skiing; trails open but ungroomed.

comment: Trails are explicitly not groomed or maintained in winter; skiing is permitted backcountry-style. Date used is the 2026 operating-season date on the page, not a ski-specific date. Consider medium if ungroomed areas should rank lower.

No trace of this club name found. Coordinates are about 8 km NW of Lachute, near Parc Nature du Lac Beattie (Gore/Lachute regional park, XC ski listed, cantondegore.qc.ca, founded 2013). Possibly the same trails under a new operator, but unconfirmed. Jan 2026 Review article on Argenteuil winter trails names no such club.

evidence.summary: Tourism listing for Great Blue Heron park Emma Lake trails says trails are groomed for skiing in winter.

suggestedName: Great Blue Heron Provincial Park - Emma Lake
comment: Emma Lake Recreation Site was folded into Great Blue Heron Provincial Park (2013). Sask Parks page is script-rendered and could not be read; main groomed network seems to be at Anglin Lake, ~15 km away. Only undated tourism-listing evidence for Emma Lake itself. Possible overlap with any Anglin Lake / Great Blue Heron entry.

evidence.summary: Club trail report: trails groomed for skate and classic on April 3, 2026, excellent surface.

comment: Run by Pincushion Ski and Run Club, Grand Marais MN. Its Facebook link is labelled North Superior Ski and Run Club, possibly an older name.

comment: Grand Rapids MN. Station is now called North Central Research and Outreach Center (NCROC). Page footer says current as of Nov 2026 but that may be site-wide; grooming not mentioned.
